notes: kb/Work PB5242 landed. §1985:XIII.3.8.2 (the PDF page rendered) prints `PAGE [LIMIT IS | LIMITS ARE] integer-1 [LINE | LINES] [HEADING integer-2] [FIRST DETAIL integer-3] [LAST DETAIL integer-4] [FOOTING integer-5]`, only PAGE, HEADING, FIRST, DETAIL, LAST and FOOTING underlined, so `PAGE IS 20`, `PAGE ARE 20` and `PAGE LIMIT 20` are COBOL-85 (each word of the bracket is optional, the reading kb/Work PB3751 gives the 2023 bracket). The 2002 additions are construct report-page-forms-2002: the page width `integer-2 {COLS | COLUMNS}` and integer-1 omitted (VisitReportPageClause; 2002 13.16.37.2 SR2), and LAST CONTROL HEADING / LAST CH, the DE abbreviation and IS before a phrase's integer (VisitReportPageSubclause; 2002 13.16.37.2 SR1). Witnesses: 1985-FMT-XIII_3_8_2 and pb5242-page-forms-85. Each 2002 form is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900 by a construct row of the version matrix (tests/version-matrix/constructs/report-*-2002.json, introducedIn 2002), checked on recognition in VersionConformancePass's parse arm, and accepted from COBOL-2002 (ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 115).

next.reason: 1985 PAGE: 'PAGE {LIMIT IS|LIMITS ARE} integer-1 {LINE|LINES} [HEADING integer-2] [FIRST DETAIL integer-3] [LAST DETAIL integer-4] [FOOTING integer-5]' (§1985:XIII.3.8.2); any phrase order is already 1985 (§1985:XIII.3.8.3 SR1), restated by §2023:13.18.39.3 SR4. 2023 (§2023:13.18.39.2) adds 'integer-2 {COLS|COLUMNS}', makes integer-1 optional ('Either integer-1 or integer-2 or both shall be specified', §2023:13.18.39.3 SR2, with the phrases allowed only when integer-1 is given, SR3), adds LAST CONTROL HEADING, optional IS before each integer, and the synonyms FIRST DE, LAST CH, LAST DE (§2023:13.18.39.3 SR1). Every 1985 clause keeps its meaning; 2023 accepts clauses the 1985 format refuses (looser).
